title: Soulfire
wikitext:
{{status | name = Soulfire | type = Debuff | description = You are taking fire damage over time

The light of the dead
Burns flesh from thy mortal frame
Only bones remain }} '''Soulfire''' is a [[debuff]] that deals [[Fire damage]] over time. This debuff can stack. It is applied by the Soul Lanterns and Ghostfire Aura while fighting [[Captain Clayborne, The Accursed]] in {{il|Frozen Cabins Map}}. [[Category:Debuffs]]
